+"""
+Loads image bytes from a path users can set (cut image_path, character and
+style image URLs, ...).
+
+Only two kinds of sources are accepted:
+- data: URLs (decoded in memory)
+- objects in our own storage, given either as a relative path or as a full
+  URL under settings.STORAGE_HOST (read through the storage service)
+
+Any other URL is refused and never requested, so a user cannot make the
+backend fetch an address of their choosing (SSRF).
+"""
+import base64
+import binascii
+import posixpath
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+
+def _storage_key_from_url(url: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Returns the storage key if `url` points into STORAGE_HOST, else None."""
+    host = settings.STORAGE_HOST
+    if not host:
+        return None
+    try:
+        base = urlsplit(host)
+        target = urlsplit(url)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    if target.scheme.lower() != base.scheme.lower():
+        return None
+    if target.netloc.lower() != base.netloc.lower():
+        return None
+    if target.query or target.fragment:
+        return None
+    prefix = base.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+    if not target.path.startswith(prefix):
+        return None
+    return _clean_key(unquote(target.path[len(prefix):]))
+
+
+def _clean_key(key: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Rejects empty keys and keys that try to leave the bucket."""
+    key = key.lstrip("/")
+    if not key or "\\" in key:
+        return None
+    if any(part in ("..", ".") for part in key.split("/")):
+        return None
+    if posixpath.normpath(key) != key:
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def resolve_storage_key(path: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Maps a user-settable image path to a key in our storage, or None if it
+    is not a storage object (including any non-storage URL)."""
+    if not path or path.startswith("data:"):
+        return None
+    if "://" in path or path.startswith("//"):
+        return _storage_key_from_url(path)
+    if ":" in path.split("/", 1)[0]:
+        # Some other scheme (file:, gopher:, ...)
+        return None
+    return _clean_key(path)
+
+
+def _decode_data_url(path: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    try:
+        header, encoded = path.split(",", 1)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    try:
+        if header.endswith(";base64"):
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=False)
+        return unquote(encoded).encode("latin-1")
+    except (binascii.Error, ValueError, UnicodeEncodeError):
+        return None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(path: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Returns the image bytes for `path`, or None if the source is missing,
+    not allowed, or unreadable. Never makes a request to a URL from `path`."""
+    if not path:
+        return None
+    if path.startswith("data:"):
+        return _decode_data_url(path)
+    key = resolve_storage_key(path)
+    if key is None:
+        return None
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    return storage.download_image(key)

+"""Exports say which cuts they left out: a missing.txt in the ZIP and an
+X-Missing-Cuts header on both formats."""
+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG, FakeMinio
+
+DATA_URL = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+
+
+def put_in_storage(key, body=PNG):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    FakeMinio.objects.setdefault(settings.MINIO_BUCKET, {})[key] = body
+
+
+def make_episode(client, h, image_paths):
+    """Creates an episode with one cut per entry (cut numbers 1, 2, ...)."""
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": r.json()["id"], "episode_order": 1})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    episode_id = r.json()["id"]
+    for order, path in enumerate(image_paths, start=1):
+        r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": order, "image_path": path})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return episode_id
+
+
+def export(client, h, episode_id, fmt):
+    return client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+
+
+MIXED = [
+    DATA_URL,                                   # 1 ok
+    None,                                       # 2 no image yet
+    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/", # 3 refused address
+    "cuts/missing/nowhere.png",                 # 4 not in storage
+    DATA_URL,                                   # 5 ok
+]
+
+
+def test_zip_lists_missing_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_episode(client, h, MIXED)
+    r = export(client, h, episode_id, "zip")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4"
+    zf = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content))
+    assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode().splitlines() == ["2", "3", "4"]
+    assert len([n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith(".png")]) == 2
+
+
+def test_zip_without_missing_cuts_has_no_list(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_episode(client, h, [DATA_URL, DATA_URL])
+    r = export(client, h, episode_id, "zip")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+    assert "missing.txt" not in zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)).namelist()
+
+
+def test_webtoon_header_lists_missing_cuts(client):
+    put_in_storage("cuts/broken/not-an-image.png", b"this is not a png")

+    r = export(client, h, episode_id, "webtoon")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4,6"
+    assert r.content.startswith(b"\x89PNG")
+
+
+def test_webtoon_without_missing_cuts_has_no_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_episode(client, h, [DATA_URL, DATA_URL])
+    r = export(client, h, episode_id, "webtoon")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+def test_missing_cuts_header_is_exposed_to_browsers(client, fmt):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_episode(client, h, [DATA_URL, None])

+                    headers={**h, "Origin": "http://localhost:3000"})
